description: TechPylon annotated bench seed set. Gold annotations per field; grows toward the 1,400-case target with credentialed safety-reviewer sign-off. Used by the bench harness (make bench), calibration (make calibrate) and classifier training (make train-models).

cases.text:
Patient: Jane Doe, 34F
Drug: Amoxicillin 500mg, started 12 Oct
Event: Patient experienced a severe rash (pruritic) five days into treatment.
Reported by: Dr. K. Adeyemi, Lagos
The reaction was serious, requiring hospitalisation. Rash is a known labelled reaction to penicillins, considered expected.

expected.event: Patient experienced a severe rash (pruritic) five days into treatment

cases.text:
Patient name: Chinedu Okafor
Medication: Ibuprofen 400mg
Reaction: mild nausea after first dose
Reported by: Pharm. S. Bello
No hospitalisation; the patient stayed at home. Nausea is a known effect of NSAIDs.

Patient: Fatima Bello, 2F
Product: Paracetamol syrup
Reaction: fever continued, no improvement
Reported by: Guardian, Mrs. Bello
Treating clinician says the fever is unexpected given the therapy.

Patient: Emeka Nwosu, 56M
Drug: Artemether/Lumefantrine
Event: Jaundice and dark urine noticed on day 3.
Reported by: Dr. A. Hassan, UNILAG clinic
Outcome: fatal. Liver failure diagnosed post-mortem. Considered an unexpected event.

expected.event: Jaundice and dark urine noticed on day 3
